body.rationale: The IPS is a draft, so I weigh judgment over strict compliance. I am tail_risk_parity and have excluded myself. I favour portfolios that pass the draft IPS or come close, and that rely on covariance structure over forecasts, in line with the late-cycle finding in §4.3. First is resampled_efficient_frontier: it passes every hard limit, is the most diversified compliant option (effective N 13.3, TE 4.33), and its reviewers found only a mislabelled gamma description, not an execution error. Its main weakness is drawdown headroom under 1 point (-24.3% vs -25%). Second is pc_researcher: its Sharpe is among the highest (0.51), its drawdown is modest (-10.9%), its CRO risk is low (0.33), and it breaches only two limits (volatility band and TE, narrowly). Its reviewers flagged a mismatch between the narrative and the solved result, which keeps it from first. Third is black_litterman: compliant, effective N 6.1, backtest Sharpe 0.70, with the only error being the Omega mechanism description. Fourth is cvar_minimization: compliant with a good backtest Sharpe (0.74), a drawdown of -18.7%, and direct treatment of tail risk. Its weakness is fitting to a handful of crises and a return floor tuned to the band edge. It is also a different family from the return-optimised picks, which helps meet the family-spread rule. Fifth is max_sharpe: compliant, but 46% in us_value reflects one judged CMA gap and its drawdown (-24.7%) is close to the limit. Resampled beats max_sharpe because averaging over draws diffuses that CMA sensitivity. The first choice beats the fifth on diversification (13.3 vs 3.8 effective N), drawdown headroom, and less dependence on a single return-gap input. I flag market_cap_weight: it has a -40.6% drawdown, CRO risk of 0.80, and a hard drawdown breach. Reviewers also showed the ETF-AUM proxy is not a valid capitalisation weight, with double-counting of overlapping classes. The CIO should not lean on it. I left the adversarial diversifier unflagged because its orthogonality has ensemble value, even though it breaches three limits.
